meta.source_note: Real-world brand metrics from brand_metrics_merged.xlsx (BrandZ, Kantar, Wikipedia, Nexis Uni, Google Trends, Statista, and Brandwatch) with finalized manually double-coded Aspiration Scores (1-5). LLM metrics (cf_/nb_ prefixes) were recomputed directly from study1_main_clean.csv (2026-08-11 export) and study3_main_clean.csv (2026-08-07 export), not from the older data/analysis/rq1/brand_recommendation_rates.csv, which used a since-repaired data vintage.
meta.coverage_note: The analysis covers the 104-brand universe in brand_metrics_merged.xlsx across all 5 categories. Brandwatch mention volume is populated for 103 of 104 brands; City Cruises by Hornblower is missing. BrandZ equity columns (Meaningful, Different, Salient, Demand Power, and Pricing Power) are populated for 45 brands. Final Aspiration Score is populated for 103 of 104 brands.
meta.brandwatch_note: Brandwatch mention volume is a sampled estimate from a 12-month window (5% sample scaled ×20). It is intended for relative comparison across brands, not as an exact count. Coverage is driven mainly by Reddit, Bluesky, news, blogs, and forums; X, TikTok, and Instagram contribute little because of restricted third-party data access. Interpret this measure as online-conversation / earned-media salience, not social performance.
meta.method_note: Pearson correlation, brand-level, pooled across all 5 categories (not category-controlled). Money and count predictors, including Brandwatch mention volume, are natural-log(1+x) transformed before correlation. Aspiration Score is the finalized continuous 1-5 rating from the revised coding sheet, not the Low/Mid/High bucketing used only for chart color.
meta.excluded_note: Category Awareness (%) is deliberately left out of this correlation list. Its own source metadata labels it “market share,” not “awareness,” and its Statista collection window differs widely by category (Boat Cruise 2019, Cat Food 2019, Coffee Maker 2025, Cordless Drills 2017, Hiking Jacket 2024). Correlating an eight-year-spread survey metric against a single-vintage LLM run risks confounding survey year with brand strength. The raw figure remains in the brand-level table for reference.
